stateNote: Loosely roll the dough around your rolling pin, and center it over the quiche ring. Carefully working in a circle, tuck in the dough to make an even-bottomed, even-walled shell. Wrap the excess dough around the outside of the ring and press it down there, but keep it thick around the top of the ring. This will keep the dough from sagging or tearing around the top as it bakes. This step is the tricky one, so take your time and tuck the shell well into all the gaps, patching it smoothly anywhere it tears and pressing it even wherever there are thick folds. Along the outside of the ring, cut any dough that reaches down more than 1.25 inches. You can use this to patch any tears later.
